annotations.title: NIH dbGaP studies sequenced on BGI/MGI machines

description: NIH controlled-access (dbGaP) human studies whose sequencing runs in ENA were made on BGI/MGI instruments (DNBSEQ, BGISEQ, MGISEQ), each joined to its NIH grant (from the dbGaP study record, or an identical-title NIH RePORTER project), with the grantee, PI, project end date, RePORTER award amounts and the ledger's rule status (BIOSECURE no-grace, UFLPA import presumption since Oct 29 2026). Free.
